sources.note: No descriptive references at all: only Oosterwal 1961, Galis 1955 and van der Leeden 1954, each classed 'Wordlist or less'; classification Tor-Orya > Tor; no dialects listed. Local copy of hh.bib confirms every entry tagged [kwt] is overview/wordlist/socling.
No phonology at all; only classification (Foja Range > Orya-Tor > Tor > Tor Coast), four villages, ~2,000 speakers (1987), Ethnologue refs.

Its Sources list is the complete inventory of Kwesten data known to Usher: Galis 1955 (28 terms), Oosterwal 1961: 274-277 (67-79 terms) and 218-286 (kin terms), Voorhoeve 1975: 107 (39 terms after Anceaux), Smits & Voorhoeve 1994: 18-166 (comparative vocabulary after Oosterwal n.d.), Lee & Wambaliau 2004: 40-48 (239 terms) and 57-62 (21 sentences) for Kwesten of Holmafen and Arare; also 'Reimer, Songkilawand and Kana (1980) survey of Pantai Timur district (unobtained)'.
